answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to unique physical hardware: each agent must solve a per-epoch puzzle whose kernel derives from its device fingerprint, and solutions are recorded in a shared atlas that maps identities to compute. Duplicate fingerprints or cloned keys get rejected at the canyon checkpoint where stake is slashed. An attacker must acquire and solve independently for every fake identity, making mass registration cost more than the rewards it could capture. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
